description: List every URL on a website, with its HTTP status code and link depth, without fetching page content. Finds URLs from links and sitemaps, and includes estimatedCredits for crawling the pages that load. Costs 1 credit per 1,000 URLs. Use it to see a site before crawling, find broken pages, or build a URL inventory

allowPatterns.description: Only list URLs that match one of these patterns, e.g. "/blog/*"

denyPatterns.description: Skip URLs that match one of these patterns, e.g. "/tag/*" or "/login"

maxDepth.description: How many links away from the start URL to go, up to 10

maxPages.description: The most URLs to return. Defaults to 500, up to 10,000

timeout.description: Seconds to look before returning what it has found

url.description: Where the map starts. Any public URL, or a sitemap URL to list every page in it

name: map
